evaluation_criteria.quote: Stage 2: Rated Criteria 80 60% (48 overall points) 1. Overall Experience 20 2. Project Schedule & Approach 20 3. Solution Capability 20 4. Training Services 10 5. Warranty, Support, and Maintenance 10

pricing_structure.quote: Each Proposal must include a completed Pricing Submission Form (Appendix F) that complies with the instructions contained in the RFP, and that provides all requested pricing information.

insurance_requirements.quote: Professional Liability Insurance in the amount of One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) covering actual or alleged acts, errors or omissions committed by the Supplier, Supplier Subcontractors or their respective agents or employees, arising out of the performance of this Agreement. The policy coverage will also extend to include personal injury, bodily injury and property damage from the performance of professional service or arising out of the program.

vendor_experience_required.quote: The Supplier shall provide a Technical Lead to provide overall design, configuration, and integrations of the Solution. The Technical Lead shall, as a minimum, have the qualification set out below: a) Two (2) or more years of SQL database implementation experience; b) Two (2) years of experience related to implementation of SQL database projects of similar scope; and c) Experience with all aspects of integration, quality assurance and testing pertaining to SQL database implementations.
vendor_experience_required.value: Two (2) or more years of SQL database implementation experience; Two (2) years of experience related to implementation of SQL database projects of similar scope; Experience with all aspects of integration, quality assurance and testing pertaining to SQL database implementations.

references_required.quote: The Proponent should provide three (3) references.

data_security_requirements.quote: As part of their commitment to safeguard TTC records, the supplier shall implement network segmentation using the principles described in the Purdue Model IEC-62443. The supplier shall establish and maintain network segmentation controls that align with industry best practices. This includes: a) Clearly defined network zones based on logical boundaries, such as departments, functions, or system types b) Access controls such as firewalls, VLANs, or VPNs to regulate traffic flow between network segments and restrict unauthorized communication
value: Implement network segmentation using the principles described in the Purdue Model IEC-62443.
Establish and maintain network segmentation controls that align with industry best practices.
Clearly defined network zones based on logical boundaries, such as departments, functions, or system types.
Access controls such as firewalls, VLANs, or VPNs to regulate traffic flow between network segments and restrict unauthorized communication.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: The Proponent will bear all costs associated with or incurred in the preparation and presentation of its Proposal, including, if applicable, costs incurred for interviews or demonstrations.
